rule: deferrals: a name the crate references, or an authority unit calls, that no stratum has built yet. divergences: a name an authority unit calls that the crate deliberately does not, with the class of the difference and the reason. `covers` is exact in both directions.

units: an authority translation unit a subphase plan names, which no transcription edge, no built internal function, no referenced identifier and no symbol record reaches. divergences.note: The one internal of `crypto/bn/bn_intern.c` this crate gives no function, and it is a storage-model divergence rather than a withheld one.
